item.title: Using Local Keep
item.description:
Open the interactive demo or launch it directly from the portfolio card. Local Keep runs entirely in your browser with native DOM APIs and no backend service.

Everyday workflow

  • Create and edit notes and checklists, pin important items, assign colors and labels, and move items between Archive and Trash.
  • Search titles, note bodies, checklist rows, and labels from the header search bar.
  • Use keyboard navigation and the focus-contained edit dialog (Escape saves changes and returns focus to the triggering note).
  • Export a versioned JSON backup (including archived and trashed items) before clearing browser storage or moving devices.
  • Import a previous JSON export additively without overwriting existing note IDs.

Storage boundary

Notes are saved in your browser’s localStorage under this site’s origin. Deleting from Archive moves notes to recoverable Trash; Delete forever and Empty Trash require confirmation. If stored JSON becomes malformed, Local Keep exposes a raw JSON recovery download instead of silently wiping existing notes.

item.title: Source and implementation notes
item.description:
A free, browser-only notes and checklist application built with native DOM APIs, CSS, localStorage, and Webpack. It deliberately has no account, server, or cloud dependency.

Open interactive demo · Back to portfolio

Features

  • Create and edit notes and checklists; pin, color, label, archive, trash, and restore them.
  • Search titles, bodies, labels, and checklist text from the header search control.
  • Use keyboard navigation, named controls, and a focus-contained edit dialog (Escape saves and returns focus).
  • Export versioned JSON including archived/trashed notes and labels; validate and merge imports without replacing existing IDs.
  • Preserve drafts when a storage write fails, display an error, and allow retry.
  • Recover raw stored JSON if existing notes are malformed, without silently resetting user data.
  • Responsive layout with readable colored notes and reduced-motion support.

Delete from Archive moves to recoverable Trash. Delete forever and Empty Trash require confirmation. There is no automatic seven-day purge. Header Refresh reloads this browser view; the layout control switches compact display. Placeholder reminders and inactive settings controls are omitted.

item.title: Building Local Keep
item.description:
Local Keep is a vanilla JavaScript and localStorage notes application built with modular native DOM components and Webpack—supporting checklists, labels, colors, pinning, archive, recoverable trash, and portable JSON backups without a frontend framework.

Verification scope

  • Unit tests: cover store mutations, checklist editing, versioned backup validation, additive import with duplicate-ID protection, and rollback on partial storage failure.
  • Browser tests: exercise persistence across reloads, JSON import/export, keyboard focus containment, failed-save error states, malformed-data raw JSON recovery, and responsive layouts across phone and desktop viewports.
  • Portfolio integration: verifies opening and closing the embedded demo dialog, iframe lifecycle cleanup, and focus restoration back to the triggering control.

Boundaries

Automated accessibility and DOM checks supplement manual keyboard and visual review; they do not certify every possible browser extension or third-party environment.
